detail: self-check failed: acceptance criteria not met or not reported: "A new admission test shows a candidate that adds a new `[section]` to athena.toml together with the matching field in athena-data's Config is admitted with no 'configuration' violation. Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`."; "A new admission test shows a candidate that adds an unknown `[section]` to athena.toml without changing the schema is still refused with a 'configuration' violation naming the unknown field. Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`."; "A test shows that when the candidate's own schema check cannot run or fails, admission reports a 'configuration' violation instead of passing. Run `cargo test -p athena-core admission`."; redacted report: {"summary":"Admission now judges a changed athena.toml or defaults.toml by the candidate's own schema when the candidate changes crates/athena-data/. In that case admission writes the candidate commit's crates/athena-data/, root Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock to a temp dir. It builds a tiny checker crate against that athena-data, offline with the candidate's lock, and runs it on the file. A parse error, or a checker that cannot be built or run, becomes a 'configuration' violation carrying the real message. Without a schema change, the running Config still parses the file, as before. Root cause: the rule used the running binary's compiled Config for every candidate, so a section added together with its schema field was always refused with 'unknown field' (the q0xy and qcrz failure). defaults.toml uses the same mechanism, so it is covered. I did not touch run.rs, config.rs, core Cargo.toml or parallel-jobs.md. They are listed as deliverables, but this design needed no change to them.","files":["crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs","CHANGELOG.md"],"checks_run":[{"command":"cargo fmt --all --check","result":"pass","note":null},{"command":"cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings","result":"pass","note":null},{"command":"cargo test --locked -p athena-core admission","result":"pass","note":"9 tests passed"},{"command":"cargo test --locked","result":"pass","note":"every test binary reported ok"}],"criteria_check":[{"criterion":"A new admission test shows a candidate that adds a new `[section]` to athena.toml together with the matching field in athena-data's Config is admitted with no 'configuration' violation.","status":"met","evidence":"Test a_new_section_and_its_schema_field_together_are_admitted passes under `cargo test -p athena-core admission`."},{"criterion":"A new admission test shows a candidate that adds an unknown `[section]` to athena.toml without changing the schema is still refused with a 'configuration' violation naming the unknown field.","status":"met","evidence":"Test an_unknown_section_without_a_schema_change_is_still_refused_by_the_candidate_schema passes. It covers both a candidate whose config.rs is only touched by a comment, which goes through the candidate build, and a candidate with no schema change at all. Both are refused with 'unknown field `bogus`'."},{"criterion":"A test shows that when the candidate's own schema check cannot run or fails, admission reports a 'configuration' violation instead of passing.","status":"met","evidence":"Test a_candidate_schema_check_that_cannot_run_is_a_configuration_violation makes the candidate's config.rs fail to compile and gets one violation whose detail contains the compiler error."},{"criterion":"admission.rs documents (module comment and rule comment) that a changed athena.toml is judged by the candidate's schema, and states how the candidate's schema is obtained.","status":"met","evidence":"The module doc bullet, the comment above the configuration rule, and the doc comment on check_with_candidate_schema were all updated."},{"criterion":"The existing admission tests (bad athena.toml, defaults.toml, docs/athena.toml) still pass; `cargo test` passes and `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.","status":"met","evidence":"The existing admission tests pass. `cargo test --locked --quiet` showed no failures in any test binary. `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` produced no warnings or diffs."},{"criterion":"Outcome check: the failure text from jobs 20261016-071202-q0xy and 20261016-185517-qcrz (`unknown field parallel` when athena.toml and the schema change together) is reproduced by a test and no longer occurs.","status":"met","evidence":"The test a_new_section_and_its_schema_field_together_are_admitted first asserts that the running Config::parse gives 'unknown field `parallel`' for the same text. It then asserts that admission with the schema change yields no configuration violation."},{"criterion":"CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the admission change, if the repository's CHANGELOG convention covers behavior changes.","status":"met","evidence":"A new bullet under [Unreleased] / Changed describes the root cause, the mechanism, and the landing caveat."}],"open_issues":["Landing, via athena_gate::config_at (crates/athena-gate/src/lib.rs line 140), still parses athena.toml with the running binary's Config. A landed config-plus-schema change is refused or unreadable by an older binary until Athena is rebuilt. I noted this in CHANGELOG.md and did not fix it, since the job's scope is admission.","The candidate check builds with the candidate's Cargo.lock and `--offline`. A candidate that adds a new crate dependency to athena-data and is not in the local cargo cache fails closed with a configuration violation. That is the intended fail-closed behavior, but it can be a false refusal.","Each such check builds against CARGO_TARGET_DIR if set, so repeat runs reuse the cache; otherwise it builds in a temp dir, which is slow (tens of seconds)."],"mistakes":[],"learnings":["admission.rs's `Config::parse` is the base binary's schema; the candidate commit is never built before admission, so any candidate-schema check has to build its own athena-data.","A standalone temp crate with `[workspace]` and a path dependency on the extracted athena-data builds fine without the other workspace members present.","The producer shell forbids cat, grep, tail and pipes. Use the Read and Grep tools, and `cargo test --quiet` for compact output."],"desires":["A way to read truncated tool output files inside the working directory."]}

policy_denials.detail: cat crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml crates/athena-data/Cargo.toml; grep -n "pub fn parse" -B3 -A12 crates/athena-data/src/config.rs; grep -n "pub fn \(show_file\|run\|isolated\|ls_tree\|archive\|root\)" crates/athena-git/src/*.rs; sed -n 125,160p crates/athena-gate/src/lib.rs; head -30 CHANGELOG.md; grep -n "admission\|unknown" docs/design/parallel-jobs.md | head -20
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p athena-core admission 2>&1 | tail -40
